description: This file provides mocking support functions and macros for unit testing within the Zephyr project, specifically for ztest framework. It defines macros for setting expectations, returning data, and checking values, as well as function prototypes for mock initialization and cleanup.

methods.name: z_cleanup_mock
methods.description: Cleans up mock environment for ztest.

methods.name: z_ztest_expect_value
methods.description: Sets expectation for a function parameter value.

methods.name: z_ztest_check_expected_value
methods.description: Checks if a parameter matches the expected value.

methods.name: z_ztest_expect_data
methods.description: Sets expectation for a function parameter data.

methods.name: z_ztest_check_expected_data
methods.description: Checks if data pointed by a parameter matches expected data.

methods.name: z_ztest_return_data
methods.description: Sets data to be returned by a function.

methods.name: z_ztest_copy_return_data
methods.description: Copies the set return data to a specified memory location.

methods.name: z_ztest_returns_value
methods.description: Sets the return value for a function.

methods.name: z_ztest_get_return_value
methods.description: Retrieves the return value set for the current function.
